model_annotation: Figure 4, titled "zugewanderte seit 2010," is a line chart that compares two distinct groups over time, with the x-axis representing the years from 2010 to 2020 and the y-axis indicating the number of individuals, scaled linearly from 0 to 1,000,000 in increments of 200,000. The chart displays two lines: a solid blue line labeled "zugewanderte seit 2010" and a dashed black line labeled "zugewanderte bis 2009." The solid blue line begins at a value of approximately 100,000 in 2010 and shows a consistent upward trend, reaching a value of approximately 900,000 by 2020. The dashed black line starts at a value of approximately 100,000 in 2010, rises to a peak of approximately 250,000 in 2012, and then exhibits a general downward trend, ending at a value of approximately 150,000 in 2020. The source of the data is cited as "Mikrozensus 2019, eigene Auswertungen."
